provenance: Every figure below was retrieved by web search on 2026-09-10 and is attributed to the outlet that reported it. Private-company valuations are reported figures, not audited. Rounds reported as 'in talks' are labelled unconfirmed. The Stanford tie states the specific relationship (current faculty / lab of origin / PhD alumnus / student / dropout / research partner) because those are materially different things.

companies.name: Physical Intelligence
companies.stanford_tie: Co-founded by Chelsea Finn, current Stanford CS faculty (IRIS lab); other founders from Google DeepMind and UC Berkeley
companies.what: Robot foundation models (pi-0) trained on vision-language-action data
companies.valuation_note: $5.6B confirmed at the $600M Series B, Nov 2025, led by Google CapitalG. Bloomberg reported talks in Mar 2026 for ~$1B more at above $11B; not publicly confirmed as closed.
companies.investors: CapitalG, Jeff Bezos, Thrive Capital, Lux Capital; Founders Fund and Lightspeed reported in the unconfirmed round

companies.name: World Labs
companies.stanford_tie: Founded by Fei-Fei Li, current Stanford CS faculty and HAI advisory council co-chair
companies.what: Spatial intelligence / world models; Marble turns text, image or video into persistent downloadable 3D environments
companies.valuation_note: $5B after a $1B round closed 18 Feb 2026, up from $1B in Sept 2024
companies.investors: NVIDIA, AMD, Autodesk ($200M plus a strategic advisory role), Andreessen Horowitz, Fidelity, Emerson Collective

companies.name: Together AI
